title: Steve Jobs introduces the App store  - iPhone SDK Keynote
summary: Steve Jobs announces the iPhone App Store at the 2008 iPhone SDK keynote, including the 70/30 revenue split for developers and free apps at no charge.
why: Cited as the primary source for the original App Store terms and Apple's stated reason for the 30% cut.

quote.text: Job's original announcement [1] suggested that the App Store's 30% was the cost of running the App Store
